source_header: Age at diagnosis: completed years
rule: integer completed years; non-integer, non-numeric or out-of-range values rejected

source_header: Race: White, Black, Asian or Pacific Islander, or American Indian/Alaska Native
rule: exact SEER training vocabulary via 01_preprocess_seer.recode_race; unknown -> NA
allowed_vocabulary: American Indian/Alaska Native | Asian or Pacific Islander | Black | White

source_header: Sex: female or male
rule: Female -> 0, Male -> 1 (recode_sex)

source_header: Marital status at diagnosis: married or not married (married, single, divorced, widowed, separated, domestic partner, or unknown)
rule: SEER 'Unmarried or Domestic Partner' is coded married=0 in 01_preprocess_seer.py; 'Domestic partner' follows that rule. Unknown (incl. the supplied typo 'Unkown') -> married=NA.
allowed_vocabulary: Married=1 | Not married=0 | Single=0 | Divorced=0 | Widowed=0 | Separated=0 | Domestic partner=0 | unknown (incl. 'Unkown')=NA

source_header: Histological diagnosis: one of the ICD-O-3 morphology codes listed in Table 7 of the attached document
rule: ICD-O-3 code validated against ACCEPTED_HISTOLOGY_CODES; histology_paper via HISTOLOGY_LABEL_MAP; 8240/3 and 8249/3 -> 'Carcinoid tumor', other accepted codes -> 'Others' (recode_histology)

source_header: Primary pancreatic site: head, body, tail, or other pancreatic site, as defined in Table 8
rule: C25.0 Head, C25.1 Body, C25.2 Tail, other accepted C25.x -> Others (recode_primary_site)

source_header: Primary tumor extent: AJCC 7th-edition-equivalent T0, T1, T2, T3, or T4, according to Table 4
rule: T0-T4 retained (_normalize_ajcc_value); textual unknown -> NA

source_header: Radiotherapy: yes or no, according to the categories in Table 12
rule: explicit Yes/No -> 1/0; unknown -> NA (never Yes)

source_header: Chemotherapy: yes or no/unknown, following the combined SEER category
rule: explicit Yes/No -> 1/0; unknown -> NA (never Yes)

rule: trim; Yes -> 1, No -> 0 (recode_mets)

source_header: Lung metastasis at initial diagnosis: yes or no
rule: trim; Yes -> 1, No -> 0 (recode_mets)

source_header: Primary tumor size: preferably the exact largest dimension in millimetres, or one of the model categories: 0–26 mm, >26–36 mm, or >36 mm, as defined in Table 10
rule: exact mm binned <= 26 / <= 36 / > 36 (recode_tumor_size); a one-sided or interval entry sets the group only if wholly inside one category, with tumor_size_mm = NA; crossing intervals -> both NA (flagged)

source_header: Liver metastasis at initial diagnosis: yes or no. This is the outcome for the diagnostic model and identifies the patient group used by the prognostic model.
rule: trim; Yes -> 1, No -> 0 (recode_mets)

source_header: Overall survival or follow-up time: months from diagnosis to death or last follow-up
rule: numeric months >= 0, unchanged; a zero is kept here and replaced by 0.5 only for Cox evaluation in Script 2 (00_setup_prognostic.R rule), raw value kept in the local audit sidecar

source_header: Vital status at the end of follow-up: alive or dead
rule: Alive -> 0, Dead -> 1 (recode_survival)
